$comment: Source of truth for the Cloudflare MCP portal mapping of server `alice` (mctlhq/.github#35). Every tool this server registers must appear here with an explicit decision; tests/portal-allowlist.test.ts fails the build otherwise. An enabled tool must carry a `reason` that says what it exposes or changes and why that is acceptable on the shared portal -- a tool that mutates the smart home must additionally be named in mutatingOnPortal in that test. Apply with scripts/portal-allowlist-apply.sh, same operator-run flow as the other upstreams (mctl-telegram, mctl-api). All 12 tools enabled by owner decision 2026-09-22: the portal's only members are the two named addresses in infrastructure/cloudflare/account/portal-mcp-apps.tf (portal_member_alice), so this is the owner's own smart home, not a shared surface with other identities.

tools.name: alice_list_devices
tools.reason: Lists speakers, rooms and device IDs in the home; discovery only, no state change and no telemetry values.

tools.name: alice_send_command
tools.reason: Sends an arbitrary voice command to a speaker (equivalent to speaking to Alice aloud); mutating, enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_say_phrase
tools.reason: Makes a speaker say a phrase via TTS; mutating (audible side effect), enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_set_volume
tools.reason: Sets a speaker's volume level; mutating, enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_media_control
tools.reason: Controls playback (play/pause/stop/next/prev) on a speaker; mutating, enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_trigger_scenario
tools.reason: Runs a predefined Yandex Smart Home scenario by name or ID; mutating (can affect many devices at once), enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_control_device
tools.reason: Turns a device on/off or sets AC temperature/mode via the Yandex IoT API; mutating, enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_get_device_state
tools.reason: Reads real-time status/telemetry (power, voltage, temperature, humidity, battery, on/off) of a device; read-only.

tools.name: alice_get_device_history
tools.reason: Reads historical telemetry time-series and energy consumption for a device; read-only.

tools.name: alice_set_light
tools.reason: Controls a light's on/off state, brightness, color temperature or scene; mutating, enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_control_room
tools.reason: Batch turns devices in a room (or the whole home) on/off by category; mutating and the widest blast radius of any tool here, enabled by owner decision -- see mutatingOnPortal.

tools.name: alice_get_home_summary
tools.reason: Reads a combined status overview (climate, security sensors, lighting, sockets, battery levels) for the home or a room; read-only.
